release_notes: The 1.0 milestone: Orbitra grows from a click tracker into a full funnel suite. LeadForge forges ready-to-upload landing packages — order.php/thank_you.php form handlers are served through an in-process bridge so static hosting works, subid rides a hidden field or the orbitra_click cookie, and packages download via a tokenized endpoint. A built-in CRM capsule collects the leads (crm_lead creates the underlying click when none exists), with LeadForge, Tracker and CRM unified by a navbar suite switcher. TikTok joins Facebook in server-side conversions (core/TikTokConversions.php), both driven by pixel profiles with niches, event sets and test codes — schema version 26, with a migrations status panel. Tables scale now: an inline mini search sits in the header action group of Offers, Campaigns and Landings (live filter by name, URL, group, network, exact ID), and a shared pagination toolbar (Showing X-Y of N, Page Size 25/50/100/250/All remembered across tables, First/Prev/pages/Next/Last) pages through thousands of rows while TOTAL stays global over the filtered list. The navbar stops clipping on 13-14 inch laptops (xl breakpoint + full drawer below 1280px), and the dashboard sheds its horizontal scroll (responsive stat-card grid, fluid filter selectors). Stream weights are back in sight: each stream header carries the weight input plus a live share badge, balanced by a Total Stream Weight bar with a one-click Split Evenly. Campaigns gained an All-traffic-sources filter next to groups, and the Traffic Sources page now aggregates its stats in a single subquery pass with cached editor templates. Includes the previously unreleased 0.9.9.2 analytics semantics: universal CPV/EPV over all visits, pinned by hand-computed tests.
